title: Identify package manager type on the host
objective: Determine which Linux package management system is in use (apt, yum, dnf, pacman, etc.)
rationale: Different distributions use different package managers; knowing this enables correct installation verification commands
expected_output: Package manager identification result (e.g., apt for Debian/Ubuntu, yum/dnf for RHEL/CentOS)
success_criteria: Output clearly identifies the active package manager type
